usage: llm-modelbench campaign execute [-h] --config CAMPAIGN_CONFIG [--mock]

Validate a campaign JSON file, execute the normal campaign lifecycle, and
persist the immutable plan signature. Existing campaigns must have the same
signature; interrupted campaigns require campaign resume.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --config CAMPAIGN_CONFIG
                        strict campaign JSON created by campaign init
  --mock                use the deterministic offline mock backend
